hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$root/CLAUDE.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; last=$(grep -m1 -oE "[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" "$f"); [ -z "$last" ] && exit 0; last_epoch=$(date -j -f "%Y-%m-%d" "$last" +%s 2>/dev/null) || last_epoch=$(date -d "$last" +%s 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$last_epoch" ] && exit 0; days=$(( ( $(date +%s) - last_epoch ) / 86400 )); if [ "$days" -gt 30 ]; then msg="CLAUDE.md says Last updated: $last, which is $days days ago (over a month) - prompt the user to run /init to refresh it."; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$m}}'; fi
